references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
references.quote: If any public holiday falls on a rest day, the working day following immediately thereafter shall be a paid public holiday in substitution therefor.

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) (no statutory compassionate leave)
references.quote: The Act prescribes annual, sick, hospitalisation, maternity and paternity leave only; compassionate leave is a contractual grant, so its days and pay treatment follow the employer's terms.

references.title: Employment Act 1955 ss.37–44 and First Schedule para.2(5): Part IX applies to covered female employees and excludes domestic employees. Section 37 grants at least 98 consecutive days per confinement. Allowance eligibility requires at least 90 days in aggregate with the employer during the nine months immediately before confinement and employment with that employer at some time during the four months immediately before confinement (s.37(2)(a)); the surviving-natural-child limit is in ss.37(1)(c)–(d). Service with unrelated employers is not added to qualify against this employer. Sections 37(2)(d)–(3) separately govern multiple-employer claims and contributions. More favourable contractual benefits remain separate. Section 37(2)(b) and Employment (Minimum Rate of Maternity Allowance) Regulations 1976 reg.2 require each eligible calendar day at the greater of ordinary daily pay and RM6. Section 37(2)(c) deems unabated monthly wages to satisfy the allowance; daily/hourly cash targets use s.60I(1C) preceding-period ordinary wages and actual worked days. Official regulations: https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/5.%20EMPLOYMENT%20%28MINIMUM%20RATE%20OF%20MATERNITY%20ALLOWANCE%29%20REGULATIONS%201976_0.pdf Section 37(1)(c) denies allowance where there are five or more surviving children at confinement; s.37(1)(d)(i) limits that count to natural children irrespective of age. The dated natural-child count excludes adopted children, deaths before confinement and births after confinement; same-day death requires a determination of survival at confinement. Encoded 2026-10-06: eligibility admits only the allowance-bearing confinement (female, not domestic, fewer than five surviving natural children in employee.children at confinement, 90 days’ qualifying service); the no-allowance case is MATERNITY_LEAVE_NO_ALLOWANCE (paid_share = 0). The paid_share expression determines the paid proportion. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 4b): 98 days per confinement (window EVENT, entry.facts.event_id); the 90-day qualifying service is counted from employment.start_date in the nine months before confinement unless entry.facts.qualifying_service_days states it.

name: Maternity leave without allowance

references.title: Employment Act 1955 s.37(1)(a) and (c)–(d), s.37(2)(a): every covered female employee (not a domestic employee, First Schedule para.2(5)) is entitled to maternity leave of not less than 98 consecutive days per confinement, but no maternity allowance where she has five or more surviving natural children at confinement (counted from employee.children: relationship CHILD, born before and not dead at the confinement date, entry.facts.confinement_date or the leave start) or was not employed by the employer for at least 90 days in the nine months before confinement (entry.facts.qualifying_service_days, else three completed months of service). Those days are leave without pay (paid_share = 0): MATERNITY_LEAVE carries the paid case. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 4b): 98 days per confinement (window EVENT).

Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(bb) — 60 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year where hospitalisation is necessary, IN ADDITION to the s.60F(1)(aa) days since the Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 deleted the former 60-day aggregate proviso. Certification is required. No proration. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 4b): 60 days in each calendar year (window CALENDAR_YEAR). Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 7): EA s.60F(1)–(2): paid sick leave needs the certificate of a registered medical practitioner (or the employer's panel / a government medical officer, examined at the employer's expense) from the first day; an absence without it is absence without leave.

Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(aa)(i)-(iii) — 14, 18 or 22 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year by length of service, where no hospitalisation is necessary. s.60F(1) makes examination by a registered medical practitioner or dental surgeon, or by a medical officer, a condition of the entitlement, so a certificate is required from the FIRST day; s.60F(2) deems sick absence without that certificate to be absence without leave. s.60F carries no proration clause and the entitlement must not be prorated. Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 reg.8(1): a part-time employee’s sick leave is 10 days under two years’ service, 13 from two to under five, 15 from five; none on a non-working day (reg.8(2)). Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 4b): 14 / 18 / 22 days in each calendar year by service (under two years, two to under five, five or more; window CALENDAR_YEAR); part-time 10 / 13 / 15 (Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 reg.8(1)). Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 7): EA s.60F(1)–(2): paid sick leave needs the certificate of a registered medical practitioner (or the employer's panel / a government medical officer, examined at the employer's expense) from the first day; an absence without it is absence without leave.

name: Annual leave

references.title: Employment Act 1955 s.60E(1) — 8 days of paid annual leave for less than two years of continuous service, 12 days for two but less than five, and 16 days for five or more. The closing words of s.60E(1) give an employee who has not completed twelve months of continuous service during the year in which the contract terminates an entitlement in direct proportion to the number of COMPLETED MONTHS of service, which is the proration below. EA s.60E(1): a fraction of a day under a half is disregarded and a half or more is a day (`rounding: WHOLE_DAY`). EA s.60E(3A) proviso — no pay-out where the employee is dismissed under s.14(1)(a); `encash_on_exit_when` withholds the exit pay-out on a DISMISSAL recorded as `misconduct_dismissal`. EA s.60E(3B) — leave of absence without pay exceeding thirty days in aggregate in any twelve months is disregarded in computing the length of service "under this section", so the ladder reads `employment.service_months_net(["UNPAID_LEAVE"], 30.0)`: each twelve months of service counted from the start, the calendar days of approved UNPAID_LEAVE in it disregarded where they exceed thirty. Unauthorised ABSENCE is not leave granted and is not netted; s.60F's sick-leave ladder is another section and keeps plain service. Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 (P.U.(A) 302/2010) reg.7(1): a part-time employee’s annual leave is 6 days under two years’ service, 8 from two to under five, 11 from five — a ladder of its own, not the full-timer’s days prorated by hours. company policy (owner rule 2026-10-01) — unused annual leave carries into the next leave year, at most 5 days, expiring at that year’s end, unless the employee’s terms state another number (`terms.facts.annual_leave_carry_max_days`). EA s.60E(2)–(3) leave carry to the employer and employee’s agreement and set no statutory floor on what carries. EA s.60E(2) lets the leave of each twelve months of service be taken within the twelve months after them, so a year’s unused statutory days — `carry_statutory_bands`, the s.60E(1) and reg.7(1) ladders above, prorated and rounded as the grant is — carry in full, lapsing at the next year’s end; the 5-day cap (or the terms fact) limits only the company’s days above statute. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 4b): the entitlement is metered per twelve months of continuous service (window SERVICE_YEAR, EA s.60E(1)); the unused days of one service year carry into the next only (EA s.60E(2): leave of each twelve months is taken within the twelve months after them), at most that year's own entitlement, once. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 5): a PART_TIME term earns 6 / 8 / 11 days (under two years, two to under five, five or more; Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 reg.7(1)), prorated by completed months in the first year as s.60E(1) prorates the full-time days. Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 7): EA s.60E(2): an employee absent without permission and without reasonable excuse (ABSENCE days of the service year, taken_by_class.ABSENCE.service_year) for more than 10% of the working days of the twelve months (52 weeks × terms.facts.days_per_week, six unrecorded) is not entitled to that year's paid annual leave. Encoded 2026-10-08 (QA F7): EA s.60E(1) closing words and s.60E(2A) (AGC reprint read 2026-10-08): in the year in which the contract terminates, the leave accrued is in direct proportion to the COMPLETED MONTHS of that service year (the year's band × completed months ÷ 12, a half day or more a day), beside the previous twelve months' leave carried in full; s.60E(3A) pays the untaken days. When the exit is recorded and the day read falls in the exit's service year, the grant is so prorated (completed months to the day after the last day, so a full final year keeps its whole band); the first-year proration already counts completed months.
Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) (no statutory emergency leave)
references.quote: The Act grants no emergency leave; it is a contractual grant, so its days and pay treatment follow the employer's terms.

name: Paternity leave
description: Statutory leave for the first five lifetime confinements only. Before requesting leave, record the event_id and verified lifetime_number in employee facts.paternity_confinements, including previous employers, and verify the statutory notification requirement. Use the same event_id on every request for that confinement.

references.title: Employment Act1955 s60FA: seven consecutive days per confinement, married male, twelve months with the same employer, first five lifetime confinements irrespective of spouses; notification thirty days before expected confinement or as early as possible after birth. Verified paternity_confinements records supply lifetime ordinal and notification evidence. Day totals cannot determine the number of confinements.

name: Unpaid leave

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
references.quote: An employee on a monthly rate who takes unpaid leave is paid the monthly wages divided by the days of the wage period for the days eligible.

name: National service leave

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) s.18A(d), AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf, read 2026-09-30): a monthly-rated employee who took leave of absence by reason of having been called up for national service under the National Service Act 1952, to present himself for national service training under the National Service Training Act 2003 or to comply with any other written law relating to national service is paid for that month monthly wages x days eligible / days of the wage period — the same s.18A formula as unpaid leave, so the leave is unpaid (paid_share = 0) and the days are its own class, not UNPAID_LEAVE. Added 2026-09-30 (transcription: s.18A(d) was missing from every version). The Act is silent on whether the absence breaks service for s.60E; recorded default (owner rule): it does not — it is not listed in service_months_net, lawful because s.60E(1) counts continuous service and the absence is required by written law.

name: Court or custody absence

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) s.23, AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023: wages are not payable for a sentence of imprisonment, custody, travel to or from prison or custody, or travel to, attendance before or return from court otherwise than as a witness on the employer’s behalf. Section 23 also applies to domestic employees: First Schedule para.2(5) does not exclude it. The employer-witness exception preserves ordinary contractual pay; this catalogue records no independent right to time off. More favourable contractual paid absence may be granted separately. Encoded 2026-10-06: the absence is unpaid (paid_share = 0, priced by NO_PAY_LEAVE at monthly ÷ 26); attendance as the employer’s witness is work for the employer, not this class, and is refused here.
